images.filename: Storage jar with the face of the Egyptian god Bes, Brighton Museum and Art Gallery.jpg
images.caption:
This jar had been placed in the corner of a rectangular brick grave. No body was found. The burial had been robbed in the past and few objects remained. In ancient Egypt, Bes was a god who protected the family, especially children.
Napatan Period (750 BC - 555 BCE)

From Sanam, Grave NI/772 (excavated by the University of Oxford)
